items.long_description:
The photo shows a close-up, slightly low-angle view of a large pile of rolled documents resting on a light-colored flat surface, likely a table. There are about two dozen rolls, piled and overlapping in a mound. Each roll is a hollow cylinder made of tan or yellowish paper with some orange-brown edges and layers visible at the ends. The hollow centers show multiple coiled layers and faint, indistinct dark printing or markings inside, but no readable text is visually discernible as ballots from the image alone. Several rolls are loosely secured with white bands. About six to seven rolls are visible in the front row with more stacked behind, varying slightly in diameter and length.

The background is out of focus and blurred, showing muted light tones and indistinct shapes suggesting an indoor space, without clear details.

Overlaid across the middle-left of the image is prominent white uppercase text reading DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS on a semi-transparent dark rectangular band, standing out against the rolls. The image also has thin design borders: a bright lime-yellow vertical strip along the left edge and a dark teal horizontal strip along the top edge.

items.alt_text: Three horizontal box plots compare purchaser ages for BMW 3, 5, and 7 series, showing age increasing with higher series.
items.long_description:
This figure shows three horizontal box plots sharing a common horizontal numeric scale. The surrounding text indicates the numbers represent purchaser age in years. The horizontal axis has arrows at both ends, with labeled ticks at 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80 and minor ticks between each labeled tick. The vertical arrangement lists BMW 3 series at the top, BMW 5 series in the middle, and BMW 7 series at the bottom. Each plot has a box with a dashed vertical median line inside and whiskers extending left and right to the minimum and maximum.

For BMW 3 series (top): the left whisker end (minimum) is at about 23; the left edge of the box (first quartile) is at about 28 to 29; the dashed line inside the box (median) is at about 33; the right edge of the box (third quartile) is at about 41 to 42; the right whisker end (maximum) is at about 66.

For BMW 5 series (middle): the minimum is at about 32; the first quartile is at about 39 to 40; the median is at about 41 to 42, just to the right of the left box edge; the third quartile is at about 55; the maximum is at about 63 to 64.

For BMW 7 series (bottom): the minimum is at about 36; the first quartile is at about 41 to 42; the median is at about 46 to 47; the third quartile is at about 59; the maximum is at about 67.

Overall, the boxes and medians shift to the right to higher values from 3 series to 5 series to 7 series, indicating older purchasers for higher series. The 3 series has a short box with a long right whisker.
